subject: Post-demo: hosted API cost envelope, commitment levers & 99th-pt spike profile
messages:
From: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@nimblehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: pricing@nimblehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-19T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + numbers from today's demo

Thanks for the walkthrough today — helpful to see the hosted API latency profiles and the canary rollback flow. Two quick asks so we can land internal budget approvals: 

1) Confirm our expected shape (please see attached CSV):
   - Estimated active monthly requests: ~500k calls/month
   - Avg tokens per call: ~500 tokens (prompt ~120, completion ~380)
   - Expected monthly token volume: 250M tokens (range: 180M - 320M)
   - Typical concurrency: baseline 25 TPS, peak bursts to 120 TPS (we see 99th-pt sustained ~95 TPS in busy windows)

2) Pricing ask: we are targeting a target $/1M token band to build into our forecast. Rough internal target is $8 - $12 per 1M tokens for hosted API (no dedicated commitment yet). Can you: (a) confirm feasible hosted pricing bands for ~200-300M/month, (b) note any required commit levels for the lower band, and (c) call out any egress/ops add-ons we should expect?

If easier, a short table with a conservative run (180M), expected (250M) and upside (320M) with list price and committed price would be perfect. Hoping to get something by Friday so we can slot it into our Q4 budget ask.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Platform, NimbleHealth
Marcus Lee
marcus.lee@nimblehealth.com
(415) 555-0128

Attachment: nimblehealth_usage_snapshot_aug2026.csv (CSV, 44KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + numbers from today's demo

Marcus — thanks for the clear summary and the CSV. I pulled the team in and sketched a quick set of options below. High level thoughts first: your size and burst profile are squarely in the hosted API zone for a first phase; committed pricing materially improves unit economics but we can present a short-term hosted quote plus an option to convert to a reserved plan.

Ask: can you confirm whether the 120 TPS spikes are single-region or global-fanout? Also wondering about QPS smoothing — any chance some of that 120 TPS is GPU-batch-friendly (i.e., many small requests aggregated via client-side queue)? If yes, that changes batching economics.

Draft deliverable I will send: short table (conservative/expected/upside) with list hosted price, 3-month committed price, and brief notes on SLA and spikes. Also include a sample $/1M impact calc for your 250M baseline.

Next steps:
 - We will share the price table + short justification by EOD tomorrow.
 - If that looks good, propose a 30-minute follow-up on Thursday to walk finance & infra through the math.

Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Attachment: demo_clip_trim_15s.mp4 (MP4, 2.7MB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T20:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: hosted pricing sketch for NimbleHealth (do not share raw)

Internal notes and recommended customer-facing table — DO NOT SHARE RAW. Short version we can support Marcus' $8-12 target but with conditions.

Assumptions: avg call = 500 tokens; 250M monthly tokens = 500k calls. Peak 120 TPS sustained for short windows; 99th-pt ~95 TPS. Model variant used in demo: mid-sized LLM (we can quantify model family on the quote).

Suggested customer bands (hosted API):
 - List hosted price: $16 / 1M tokens (no commit)
 - Entry committed band (3 month, 50M/month committed): $11 / 1M tokens
 - Mid committed band (6 month, 150M/month committed): $8 / 1M tokens
 - Volume conversion note: for monthly spikes above committed level, we apply burst rates at +25% of committed price for overflow.

Sample math (expected run = 250M):
 - If on list price: 250 * $16 = $4,000/month
 - If 6-month mid committed band ($8/1M): 250 * $8 = $2,000/month
 - If they convert to Dedicated later, further unit cost reductions possible (we can include GPU pool pricing separately).

SLA and ops notes to include on quote:
 - 99th-pt latency SLO: 1.2s for the demo model in us-west region under normal load (documented in console)
 - Spikes: we can absorb short spikes to 120 TPS, but sustained >90 TPS requires advance notice for burst capacity reservation or temporary autoscale (ops may require 6–12 hour lead time for sustained multi-hour spikes)

Risks / clarifying asks for the customer:
 - Confirm if spikes are single-region or globally distributed
 - Confirm split prompt vs completion tokens over different endpoints (chat vs batch embeding)

If you want, I can turn the above into a concise 1-page price table + recommended commit ask and a short justification paragraph.

Marissa
Director, Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: pricing_bands_sketch_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)

From: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@nimblehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: pricing@nimblehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-20T10:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted API cost envelope, commitment levers & 99th-pt spike profile

Thanks — that table is exactly what we needed. A couple of clarifying notes before we lock in the ask to finance: 

1) The 120 TPS spikes are single-region (us-west) and typically last 3–7 minutes during batch processing windows. 99th-pt ~95 TPS as mentioned.
2) We're comfortable with a 3-month pilot commit of 50M/month to test the integration; if that lands well we can move to a 6-month 150M/month commit.
3) We want the hosted quote framed as a firm monthly subscription (# of committed tokens) + overage pricing. If you can include an example invoice for month 1 under both list and committed bands that'd help the procurement team.

Goal: finance wants a conservative sticker they can model: for now use the 3-month commit at $11/1M as the baseline in the ask deck, and show a conversion to $8/1M if they expand to the 6-month flow.

Please send the formal quote and a calendar link for the Thursday walkthrough.

Marcus
Head of Platform, NimbleHealth
marcus.lee@nimblehealth.com

Quoted attachments requested: example invoice, short SOW stub, DocuSign link for pilot commitment
